_comment: SCRUM-900 PROOF-SIG-01 / SCRUM-1922 — public proof-bundle + did:web signing keys. Retired keys stay listed so historical bundles remain verifiable. Rotate by editing this file + redeploying the worker; /.well-known/arkova-keys.json and /.well-known/did.json serve it. Active key PEM is the PUBLIC half of arkova1 KMS key projects/arkova1/locations/global/keyRings/arkova-signing/cryptoKeys/proof-signing version 1 (EC_SIGN_ED25519); the private key never leaves KMS. Exported via `gcloud kms keys versions get-public-key`.

keys.notes: PUBLIC key of arkova1 KMS projects/arkova1/locations/global/keyRings/arkova-signing/cryptoKeys/proof-signing/cryptoKeyVersions/1 (EC_SIGN_ED25519). Private key is non-exportable, KMS-resident. Wire PROOF_SIGNING_KMS_KEY to this resource + PROOF_SIGNING_KEY_ID=arkova-proof-2026-q2 for signed proof bundles.
